colors.name: Lavender Canvas
colors.role: Page background, hero section wash, footer background - the base atmosphere that distinguishes Reclaim from generic white SaaS

colors.name: White Surface
colors.role: Card surfaces, product mockup containers, button text on dark fills - pure white provides the resting layer above the lavender canvas

colors.name: Midnight Ink
colors.role: Supporting neutral for secondary UI, dividers, and muted labels. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

colors.name: Pure Black
colors.role: Dark supporting neutral for text, icons, and strong contrast. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

colors.name: Graphite
colors.role: Body copy and card text on light surfaces - sits just above pure black for slightly softer reading weight

colors.name: Slate
colors.role: Muted helper text, secondary descriptions, footer text - the workhorse for non-headline copy

colors.name: Charcoal
colors.role: Subheadings and emphasized body - bridges Midnight Ink headings and Slate body text

colors.name: Mist
colors.role: Hairline dividers, decorative strokes, subtle separators

colors.name: Iris Violet
colors.role: Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

colors.name: Sapphire Violet
colors.role: Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

colors.name: Lavender Mist
colors.role: Soft tints for product card highlights, decorative violet washes, outlined button borders - the muted cousin of Iris Violet

colors.name: Periwinkle
colors.role: Disabled or secondary violet state, ghost button text on violet themes

colors.name: Indigo Depth
colors.role: Dark mode gradient anchor, deep accent for special promotional sections

colors.name: Focus Green
colors.role: Green supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis

colors.name: Mint Whisper
colors.role: Light supporting surface for subtle backgrounds and section separation

colors.name: Forest Edge
colors.role: Dark green gradient stop for special promotional banners

colors.name: Brick
colors.role: Red supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

fonts.name: Poppins
fonts.role: Exclusive brand typeface used for every text element. The 300-weight whisper at 70-90px for hero headlines is the signature move - most productivity apps use bold display weights, but Reclaim's thin Poppins headlines float above the page rather than punch through it. Letter-spacing is consistently tightened at -0.01em across all sizes, giving the rounded Poppins letterforms a slightly more compact, intentional feel rather than the default airy spacing.

fonts.name: Inter
fonts.role: Secondary fallback used only in 24 specific UI spots - effectively negligible. Treat as legacy or data-table context, not a design system font.

components.name: Pill Primary Button (Violet)
components.role: Main call-to-action - 'Get started free', primary conversion actions

components.name: Pill Ghost Button
components.role: Secondary CTA - 'Book a demo' on lavender canvas

components.name: Dark Pill Button (Nav)
components.role: High-contrast nav action - 'Get Started' in the top right

components.name: Outlined Nav Button
components.role: Secondary nav action - 'Book a Demo' in top right

components.name: Calendar Time Block
components.role: Functional UI element inside the product - represents scheduled focus time

components.name: Stat Number Block
components.role: Large metric display in the social-proof band

components.name: Trust Badge Row
components.role: Social proof microcopy under hero CTAs

do: Use Poppins exclusively for all text; never substitute Inter, Roboto, or system fonts in production UI
Set border-radius to 100px for all buttons, tags, and avatars to maintain the pill-shaped identity
Use Iris Violet (#5562eb) as the single primary action color - never introduce a second blue or accent for CTAs
Keep headlines at weight 300 or 400 - never bold (600+) display text, the whisper-weight is the signature
Apply the violet-to-green gradient (linear-gradient(120deg, #5562eb 40%, #7ac17b 61%)) only to hero headline words, not to buttons or backgrounds
Use the lavender canvas (#ebefff) as the page base - white-only pages break the brand atmosphere
Reserve Focus Green (#7ac17b) for calendar time blocks and positive stat numbers, not for success toasts or status badges
doNot: Do not use drop shadows on cards - Reclaim uses border-radius and surface contrast instead of elevation
Do not introduce a new accent color (orange, pink, teal) - the system is two-color: Iris Violet + Focus Green
Do not use weight 700 or 800 for any text - Poppins tops out at 600 and most display text is 300-400
Do not use 0px border-radius on any container - minimum 3px, standard 10px for cards
Do not apply the violet-green gradient to buttons, backgrounds, or full headlines - only individual words in hero text
Do not use pure white (#ffffff) as the page background - the lavender canvas is the brand base
Do not use box-shadow for hover or focus states - use color shift to Sapphire Violet (#3451e8) instead
